entries.title: adidas × Ryoko Rain no longer includes player shoes
entries.detail: v4 listed player-exclusive footwear as part of the collaboration. The source describes Ryoko Rain as an apparel collection, and the Sabally and Cunningham shoes as part of a separate 'Crazy Energy Pack' (July 24). Records split accordingly; the adidas release itself was not opened in this review, so the record is marked single-secondary-source.

entries.title: Nike Caitlin 1 reframed as an apparel range with real prices
entries.detail: v4 treated it mainly as a shoe launch with no prices. Nike's release (Sept 14) lists 18 apparel pieces available Oct 1; a retailer listing gives 11 prices from $35 to $325. Shoe colorways launched earlier per Nike.

entries.title: Off Season: prices added, two silhouettes removed
entries.detail: v4 had no prices and named a cropped button-up and cargo shorts. Prices are $110–$185 and the corset is confirmed at $125 on the WNBA Store; no source read names the button-up or cargo shorts, so they were removed. Distribution (Off Season site, WNBA Store, Fanatics) and the four launch teams (including the Fever) added.

entries.title: Coach now has a product
entries.detail: v4 said no Coach product was found. A $95 limited-edition WNBA basketball bag charm is listed on coach.com (30th-anniversary tie).

entries.title: Four source links replaced
entries.detail: These v4 links could not be opened or confirmed in this review: the Gap Inc. site link for Athleta, the ELLE article for Catbird, the Page Six article for Off Season, and the adidas newsroom link. They are replaced with sources that were read in full (the syndicated Athleta press release, Variety, FashionUnited, Footwear Magazine). The originals may still be valid; check them if you prefer them.

entries.title: Atlanta-heavy sample broadened
entries.detail: v4 had 3 of 10 cases from the Atlanta Dream. v5 adds three Liberty records, two NWSL/club records and a price baseline, so the Atlanta share falls to 3 of 15 and patterns can be tested outside the WNBA.

entries.title: Details missing from v4 added to Dream/Monarch
entries.detail: The 'Homegrown' line, upcycled-jersey bags, ties and scarves, area codes woven into the uniform, and the fact that the Dream is described as Monarch's first WNBA client.

entries.title: Nike Rebel date made exact
entries.detail: v4 showed May 2026. Nike's release is dated May 8, 2026, with same-day availability.

entries.title: First fan-tee price baseline recorded
entries.detail: Regular-price tees at the WNBA Store: about $29.99–$39.99 (about 30 items read). Next reading due in January 2027 so the site can show whether it moves.
